atlases.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent PNG sprite atlas for an existing painted fantasy board-game map. Create exactly TWELVE separate miniature structures in exactly FOUR equal columns and THREE equal rows, row-major order. Canvas aspect4:3, preferably1536x1152. Each miniature is centered strictly inside its own equal cell, no more than65 percent cell width and height, at least17percent genuinely transparent padding on every side. Background MUST have actual transparent alpha; no checkerboard, opaque paper, terrain tiles, labels, grid lines or text. Style: gently elevated three-quarter overhead view, European storybook gouache miniatures with fine painted textures, modest readable silhouettes, low contrast earthy pigments, softly lit from upper left. Match fantasy board-map terrain rather than polished tabletop models. Tiny irregular moss/snow/grass tufts only at contact points, NO wide ground patches or opaque islands. No thick outlines, floating drop shadows, glows, bright saturated paint, characters or game tokens. All12 models same scale and view. Prioritize distinct structural silhouettes over houses. These will be drawn at40–75pixels tall on a1400px map, so avoid tiny decorative clutter.
Biome palette: golden wheat farmland: straw, ochre limestone, faded reddish-brown timber, dry gold grass at the feet.
Subjects in exact row-major order:
1. small circular roofed village well with bucket
2. compact timber granary silo on stone supports
3. small open market stall with a faded linen canopy and crates
4. low ruin of a two-arch stone aqueduct, broken ends, no landscape
5. small square stone dovecote with tiny tiled roof
6. weathered stone gate with two short ruined walls
7. ancient stone sundial sanctuary with three low pillars
8. tiny roadside stone oratory with worn statue
9. small stone quarry excavation with wooden crane and rubble
10. timber mine pithead over a dark shaft with ore bucket
11. sunken crypt entrance with stone stairs and dark open doorway
12. low limestone grotto with a wide natural dark cave opening
CRITICAL:4columns x3rows;12isolated objects, one per cell. Genuine transparency. Generous padding. Features in cells9and10must visibly read as mining works; cells11and12must visibly read as cave entrances.
